release.note: Ed25519 key from seed_hex (sha256 of "remotectl release test vector key"); key_id = hex(sha256(raw public key))[0:16]

stream_request.name: auto full color in the window

legacy_tier.name: auto capped at 30 fps is balanced

preview.note: All keys come from sha256 of a label (see proto/preview_test.go). key_message_sig is ECDSA (randomized): verify it, do not compare it. Invalid cases change one field of the valid preview; opening must fail.

unlock.note: All keys come from sha256 of a label (see proto/unlock_test.go); the unlock key is derived from the device seed. sig is ECDSA (randomized): verify it, do not compare it. Invalid cases change one field of the valid credential; opening must fail.
